laws.rule: Parque Nacional Alerce Costero: The Abuelo Alerce Milenario visit requires a reserved Pases Parques time slot, has limited capacity and is accompanied by a ranger. The page announces a second departure time from 12 November 2026, without treating this as a guarantee of a place. The named unit prohibits fires and other heat sources, pets or exotic animals, leaving enabled trails and removing natural resources. Follow ranger instructions; no region-wide extension is made.

items.text: Parque Nacional Alerce Costero: CONAF's own unit page prohibits consuming alcoholic drinks. This is the named protected-area condition, not an alcohol ban throughout the region.
